determinism: every command run twice; equal after removing elapsedMs
entry: uv run --frozen python <first word of the command line>, working directory = repo root; the driver cli_with_budgets.py only raises the two internal 2 s budgets named in largerLimits (see its docstring)
pathHandling: Each corpus file is passed to the CLI as a repo-relative path with forward slashes and the working directory is the repo root, so the CLI's own 'file' field is that relative path; the generator fails if any output holds an absolute path. Nothing needed rewriting.
